DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Hip Dislocation (Right)

Based on the mechanism of injury (rear-end collision), abnormal leg positioning, and the history of a "pop," this is a classic presentation. Although the initial X-ray was normal, the MRI request will confirm if the femoral head has reduced or if there is associated soft tissue injury like a posterior labral tear.
